wirral_boathouse_0.text: Parkgate was a busy port once, with packet boats to Ireland. Then the Dee silted up and the water went away.
Now the marsh is where the birds are. The story goes Handel waited in Chester for a fair wind, then sailed for Dublin from round here in 1741.

wirral_boathouse_1.text: On a high autumn tide the marsh floods and the wading birds pile up in thousands. Hen harriers and short-eared owls hunt here in winter.
